fichas.title: Bus dimensions and turning areas
fichas.summary: Illustrations give dimensions of widely used low-floor buses, turning circles for rigid and articulated buses, and a turning area. The turning diagrams distinguish the inner radius traced by the rear wheel from the outside of the bumper. A turning area includes a fortified area and an unpaved central area.
uses: Checking vehicle clearance and turning geometry

fichas.title: Bus stops and platform space requirements
fichas.summary: Bus stop bays are intended for main feeder roads and roads with heavy traffic loads; covering the stop is desirable. The page illustrates a bus stop with a waiting room or shelter and cycle racks, and tabulates platform layouts, platform dimensions, bus parking places, and areas for platform, roadway, and arrival lane. Ramps at the front provide access over the stated step height.
uses: Providing bus stopping and parking space
Providing accessible access to the platform

fichas.title: Bus station and parking layouts
fichas.summary: The page presents alternative bus-station arrangements, including a small turnaround station, platforms inside or outside a turning loop, and semi-circular platforms. The captions distinguish whether pedestrians must cross a road. A separate diagram shows parking spaces parallel to the direction of approach, with a stated articulated-bus spacing.
